bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W106: DCC Sandbox Preview Bridge Without Submit
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W106: DCC Sandbox Preview Bridge Without Submit. Build the review-only bridge artifacts needed for an operator to open the Demo Command Center Suitelet with IDB-provided preview parameters, compare the Suitelet preview to the DCC handoff packet, and capture approval evidence without IDB invoking SuiteScript or submitting. Preserve no IDB writes, no SuiteScript invocation from IDB, no transaction writes, hosted resolver optional until remoteSmokeExecuted=true, notes story-only, consultant confirmation required, W92 state authority, W105 operator approval preview-only behavior, and DCC ownership of item names, assemblies, BOMs, locations, planning, routing/WIP, CSV, and Sales Order mechanics. Output preview bridge contract, manual operator steps, trace samples, validator gates, W106 report, and best next Codex prompt.
